name: io.github.laufferw/agentgate
title: AgentGate — Policy-First MCP Control Plane
description: Deny-by-default policy gateway and control plane for AI agents over MCP servers and business APIs. Adds multi-tenant RBAC tokens, health-aware routing, audit logging, and transport-agnostic execution. Agent-native: agents self-register and self-discover. Compatible with streamable-http, SSE, and stdio transports.
